text:
maya: Heads up — deploybot scheduled kernel-quant swap to thermal-v2 at 22:00 UTC for staging. matmul microkernel change included. Requesting canary slice + rollback criteria. TL;DR: small perf risk on seq>2k.

liam: Can you paste the release-note blurb and artifact sha?

maya: rn: 'thermal kernel v2 — matmul refactor, quant encoding tweak. Targets: latency reduction for short seq; possible regressions on long seq.' sha: abcdef1234

olivia: Quick smoke: short-seq looks fine. Long seq (2048) p95 +8% vs baseline. logs show sporadic "kv-evict spikes". detailed run in /s/ci/1234.

arjun: @deploybot can we cut canary to 1% traffic for 30m and keep it there? gating: hold if p95 > baseline*1.5 or errors > 0.5%. Also request pin region=us-west until rollout finished.

deploybot: DeployBot: queued swap thermal-v2 -> staging slice=canary 1% start=22:00UTC

kevin: Quick local smoke command: ```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"thermal-v2","input":"<long-seq>"}' https://api.redwood/test-gen -s | jq .latency``` run before+after.

benchy: :eyes: also add kvcache hitrate gating. p95 +8% on 2048 looks borderline, want a hard gate.

liam: Propose rollback criteria: any of: (1) p95 > baseline*1.5 for 3 consecutive 5m windows OR (2) error rate increase >0.5pp over baseline OR (3) production increase in cold-start OOMs. If tripped -> immediate pin to thermal-v1 and abort canary.

maya: Agree. Also set pin-ttl=6h for night window to avoid accidental drift. I'll update release notes and add a manual rollback button in console.

deploybot: DeployBot: canary started slice=1% at 22:01UTC -> active. Observability hooks live: /dash/engine/thermal-v2/canary

olivia: Seeing initial smoke pass for short seqs. Long seq queue depth spikes at 22:05, p95 trending up. Monitoring.

arjun: If p95 >1.2x baseline within first 15m, hold further expansion. No automatic expansion until 30m stable.

maya: Acknowledged. Standing by for rollback. @kevin please prep rollback playbook steps in repo.

deploybot: DeployBot: canary health alert at 22:09UTC — p95 1.35x baseline on seq=2048; error rate +0.12pp. Alerting #eng-oncall :rotating_light:

liam: That crosses threshold. Manual decision?

arjun: Recommend pin immediate to thermal-v1 for staging canary. Maya/ops proceed?

maya: Pinning now. deploybot, pin thermal-v1 -> staging regions=us-west reason='canary p95 regression'

deploybot: DeployBot: pin applied. traffic reverted to thermal-v1. Canary aborted. Notifying release owner.

olivia: Postmortem notes: matmul kernel branch mispredicted tiling for long seq. I'll open a PR with perf guard rails and add unit perf test for seq=2048.

maya: Thanks. Will delay prod rollout until perf patch + one healthy canary run. Updating release notes and scheduling a re-run tomorrow morning window.
